summary.description: For the reviewer's report only (never posted): 2-4 plain-English sentences on what the PR does and the main concerns, if any.

path.description: File path relative to the repository root, as in the diff.

line.description: Line the comment attaches to: new-file line for RIGHT, old-file line for LEFT.

side.description: RIGHT for added/unchanged lines, LEFT for deleted lines.

startLine.description: First line of a multi-line comment; must be in the same diff hunk.

title.description: Short claim for the report issue (never posted), e.g. 'Feature flag not enforced'.

comment.description: The draft review comment, in the reviewer's voice: one concern, 1-2 sentences, usually a question that names what the author should check or do and points to existing code to follow. No evidence or call-path traces.

gapLocation.description: When the real gap is in code outside the diff (e.g. a job that should also be updated), its file:line or symbol. The comment itself stays on the related changed line.

reasoning.description: For the reviewer only (never posted): why you believe this, the code paths you traced, and evidence with file:line references.
